gloss: windbreak; wind shield; protection against the wind

definitions.gloss: windbreak; wind shield; something used to block or shelter from the wind
definitions.explanation: A fence, wall, row of trees, tarp, or other barrier placed to block wind. Also used of clothing or gear designed to protect the body from wind.

examples.japanese: テントの{周|まわ}りに{風|かぜ}よけを{立|た}てた。
examples.english: We set up a windbreak around the tent.

examples.japanese: {海岸|かいがん}の{松林|まつばやし}は{風|かぜ}よけの{役目|やくめ}を{果|は}たしている。
examples.english: The pine grove along the coast serves as a windbreak.

examples.japanese: このジャケットは{軽|かる}くて、{風|かぜ}よけにちょうどいい。
examples.english: This jacket is light and just right as protection against the wind.

notes:
Compound of {風|かぜ} ('wind') and the nominalized verb stem of {避|よ}ける ('to avoid; to ward off'). The pattern noun + {よけ} 'something to keep X away' is productive: {虫|むし}よけ ('insect repellent'), {日|ひ}よけ ('sunshade; awning'), {雨|あめ}よけ ('rain shelter').

USAGE:
Used for both permanent structures (walls, tree rows designed as windbreaks) and temporary items (tarps, camping gear). Can also describe clothing: {風|かぜ}よけのジャケット ('a windbreaker jacket'). Often appears in の-phrases modifying other nouns, e.g. {風|かぜ}よけの{塀|へい} ('windbreak wall').

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {風|かぜ}よけの{塀|へい}: windbreak wall
- {風|かぜ}よけの{林|はやし}: windbreak forest / row of trees
- {風|かぜ}よけを{立|た}てる: to set up a windbreak
- {風|かぜ}よけになる: to serve as a windbreak
- {風|かぜ}よけの{役目|やくめ}を{果|は}たす: to function as a windbreak

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {防風林|ぼうふうりん}: windbreak forest — formal term, specifically a forest planted to block wind
- {防風|ぼうふう}: wind protection — formal; {防風|ぼうふう}{壁|へき} = 'windproof wall'
- ウィンドブレーカー: windbreaker jacket
- {日|ひ}よけ: sunshade; awning — same {よけ} pattern, for sun
- {雨|あめ}よけ: rain shelter — same pattern, for rain
